source.title: Owner steps after the 26 October finish pass
source.body:
> **Current corrections — 27 October 2026.** The 07:35 snapshot below is retained as history; its unchecked boxes are not a fresh request to repeat completed actions.
>
> - **1.1, Ethereum project selection:** waived for this launch, not tested. No Ethereum qualification project needs to be created. [Recorded owner decision](https://github.com/SlopDotCash/slopdotcash/issues/1467#issuecomment-6437410696).
> - **1.4, Base funding/binding/payment/fee claim:** complete and independently reconciled. Do not repeat those transactions. The 9-USDC remainder remains in the vault; automatic monthly payment stays Off. [Completion](https://github.com/SlopDotCash/slopdotcash/issues/904#issuecomment-6438995569), [independent public verification](https://github.com/SlopDotCash/slopdotcash/issues/904#issuecomment-6440617427).
> - **3.1–3.2, team and Madyoun census exclusions:** decision resolved; no special exclusions. Historical completeness and publication holds remain. [Decision](https://github.com/SlopDotCash/slopdotcash/issues/1467#issuecomment-6437777315).
> - **3.3–3.5, appeals, pending wallet replacement and recovery:** decisions resolved; preserve the verified wallet until its replacement signs and use the approved email/self-service recovery flow. [Recorded decisions](https://github.com/SlopDotCash/slopdotcash/issues/1467#issuecomment-6437990392). Source completion does not imply latest production deployment.
> - **3.9, successful admission evidence retention:** permanent retention was approved; other scanner cases keep the existing retention policy. [Decision](https://github.com/SlopDotCash/slopdotcash/issues/1467#issuecomment-6438784205).
> - **Individual-session controls:** removal approved and implemented in merged #1538; current-session sign-out and backend validation remain. [Decision](https://github.com/SlopDotCash/slopdotcash/issues/1467#issuecomment-6439958020).
>
> - **Referral launch setup:** deferred by the owner, recorded in merged #1562. Do not request a token, funding allocation, watcher activation or testnet rehearsal for this launch. Keep the existing program Off; any reactivation needs separate owner approval. #1366 and #1430 describe deferred work, not completed acceptance.
>
> - **3.8, published Points contract:** the source correction is implemented: `protocol/scoring-v2.md` begins with Slop Points and the current 10–750 bands, with historical compatibility retained. No repeat policy decision is needed. The published `protocol/scoring-v2.md` is included in the independently verified production artifact at `a6eff743`; historical assessment completeness and Points publication remain separate gates. [Current development source](https://github.com/SlopDotCash/slopdotcash/blob/4be5d84190eda1377aaf56f496c649d29f22889f/protocol/scoring-v2.md).
> - **4.1, urgent disk space:** the owner freed space; the current read-only check reports about 373 GiB available. The immediate space request is resolved. This does not authorize deleting remaining worktrees or private evidence.
>
> - **1.3, Solana reward-token RPC:** the encrypted production `REWARD_RPC_SOLANA` binding was provisioned and read back ([evidence](https://github.com/SlopDotCash/slopdotcash/issues/1363#issuecomment-6438818986)). Do not ask the owner to enter it again. The release allowlist omitted this binding; [#1599](https://github.com/SlopDotCash/slopdotcash/pull/1599) repairs that demonstrated source mismatch. Actual token registration after release remains a separate check.
>
> **Production release verified:** [40540577525](https://github.com/SlopDotCash/slopdotcash/actions/runs/40540577525) succeeded at `a6eff743846de2d551d9feb18d71d54f2fad2d85`. Independent comparison against its retained artifact matched all 121 public files and the deployment manifest; the public skill manifest reports the same revision. This resolves the earlier inventory and ingestion release failures, and #1460 / #1466 are closed with evidence. Staging was last independently verified at `d1166ccefe5bae053c71f102ab697048d2d2405b`; its next release [40538719002](https://github.com/SlopDotCash/slopdotcash/actions/runs/40538719002) remains in progress. The scanner dispatch failure is being repaired in #1601; live scanner acceptance remains separate. Unlisted requirements retain their own current issue/evidence gates. This note grants no financial or activation authority.

---

This issue lists the steps that only the owner can do after the 26 October finish pass. The finish pass was a Claude Code workflow that started on 27 October 2026 at about 00:40 UTC. It finished open work from the 26 October agent sessions.

Snapshot: 27 October 2026, 07:35 UTC. Production serves `main` `7adb7128`. `development` is `c8930372`.

## How to use this issue

- [#1411 Part E](https://github.com/SlopDotCash/slopdotcash/issues/1411) is the main human checklist (42 items). This issue does not repeat it. Each item below is new, or it adds new evidence to a #1411 item and links to it.
- #904 (vaults and payouts), #1046 (Points), #1363 (Token-2022), #1366 and #1430 (referral) keep their own steps. This issue links to them.
- Agent work from the finish pass is in #1459, #1460, #1461, #1462, #1463, #1466 and #1471. #1466 blocks the release of `main` now. #1471 makes the escrow `evm` job fail on `development`. Codex PR #1464 already addresses #1462.
- Other open owner decisions stay in #1411 E3 (closure) and E14–E22.

**Skip these #1411 Part E items. They are done:**

- E1, payout exclusions: the owner confirmed no exclusions for November. #1414 merged at 05:25 UTC.
- E4, #1395 in production: release [40453260922](https://github.com/SlopDotCash/slopdotcash/actions/runs/40453260922) succeeded, migration `0098` was applied at 05:48:20 UTC, and `slop-slopbot` is tagged `7adb7128` ([#1411 comment](https://github.com/SlopDotCash/slopdotcash/issues/1411#issuecomment-6434918518)).
- E26, responders: lalalune is primary and drew-dot-com is backup (#1427, merged 06:43 UTC).
- E32, admin session for the census import: an import is running now (item 2.4).

**Correction to E40:** the November automatic-payment cutoff is 2026-12-04 00:00 UTC ([#1411 comment](https://github.com/SlopDotCash/slopdotcash/issues/1411#issuecomment-6434967398)). #1431 and #1440 closed; the existing monthly policy stays.

## 1. Unblocks money and launch

- [ ] **1.1 Confirm the qualification project for each network after today's registry changes.**
  - What: at 06:55–06:56 UTC the registry changed. `asi` revision 5: "Owner-directed pause and removal from featured discovery." `thenetwork` revision 4: "Move future unfunded rewards to Robinhood Chain (USDG) for network coverage." Now: `eliza` uses Solana USDC (active), `thenetwork` uses Robinhood Chain USDG (active), `asi` uses Robinhood Chain USDG (paused). No active project uses Ethereum.
  - Why: the #904 body and item 5 still name Eliza/Solana, The Network/Ethereum and ASI/Robinhood. The PRD launch order is Base, Solana, Ethereum, then Robinhood Chain. The Ethereum step has no project now. #1463 also needs this list.
  - Steps: (1) Choose the Ethereum qualification project, or record that Ethereum waits. (2) Confirm `thenetwork` as the Robinhood Chain qualification project. (3) Post the decision on #904.
  - Evidence: `GET https://slop.cash/api/v1/projects` and `GET https://slop.cash/api/v1/project-revisions` at 07:20 UTC.

- [ ] **1.2 Decide the merge rule for agents and automation (adds evidence to #1411 E6 and F1).**
  - What: merges still happen before checks finish.
    - Promotions to `main` #1426, #1447, #1449 and #1450 merged 5–12 seconds after they opened.
    - #1439 merged at 06:53:17 UTC. Its `solana` check was still running at 07:13 UTC.
    - #1442 (the referral contract change) merged at 06:59:13 UTC. Its `evm` and `solana` checks were cancelled at 07:15:38 UTC, after the merge. So the changed `ReferralDistributor.sol` has no completed hosted EVM result on its PR head.
    - #1389 merged at 03:03:49 UTC with its `evm`, `solana` and browser checks still running.
  - Why: production still serves `7adb7128`. No `main` release after it finished. `c28814f4` (run [40458432053](https://github.com/SlopDotCash/slopdotcash/actions/runs/40458432053)) waited from 05:59 UTC and then failed at 07:15 UTC: "Live main changed a slop.cash release input after c28814f4… was tested." `09313803` and `67537b69` were cancelled. `186ebc2f` (run [40464386363](https://github.com/SlopDotCash/slopdotcash/actions/runs/40464386363)) failed at 07:27 UTC because GitHub removed five merged PRs (#1466). Escrow `solana` failed on `main` `7adb7128` (run [40457915674](https://github.com/SlopDotCash/slopdotcash/actions/runs/40457915674), 3 failed Solana tests).
  - Steps: (1) Decide: merge only when every check on the exact head completed with success, or accept post-merge checks. (2) Give the rule to the Codex automation `finish-slop-rollout` and Codex thread `01a17a73`. They merge as `lalalune`. (3) After #1466 is fixed, keep `main` unchanged for about 45 minutes, so that one release can finish. Then verify it with the #1411 E4 method.

- [ ] **1.3 Check the Solana reward-token RPC setting (read-only).**
  - What: the API reads the decimals of a Solana reward token through the Pages variable `REWARD_RPC_SOLANA`. Without it, the API uses `https://api.mainnet-beta.solana.com` (`backend/projects/token-metadata.ts:28–34`).
  - Why: in a local `wrangler pages dev` run on 26 October, that default returned HTTP 403 to every owner-setup read. A normal client gets HTTP 200 (3 of 3 at 07:15 UTC). Contributor PR #1452 shows the same class of failure for Robinhood Chain in production (HTTP 429 to Cloudflare egress). If production uses the Solana default, an owner who selects a Solana token (for example PMUP, #1363) can get "The network RPC returned HTTP 403". This is not verified in production.
  - Steps: (1) Cloudflare dashboard → Workers & Pages → `eliza-computer` (production) and `slop-staging` → Settings → Variables and Secrets. (2) Check whether `REWARD_RPC_SOLANA` exists. (3) If not, set it to a Solana mainnet RPC that accepts requests from Cloudflare, then release. (4) Record the result on #1363. Also review #1452. Agents may not read or change Cloudflare settings.

- [ ] **1.4 Base qualification money steps.** No change in this pass. Follow #904 and #1411 E8–E13.
  - Before `commitAward`, confirm that `SOURCE` is `0x991cdcc980c86dee602eccb30c79290a51a67f4569b2292efad7211d62086ee3`, the SHA-256 of the published qualification source. The corrected runbook (#1385, in production since `d2417757`) and the [local-fork rehearsal](https://github.com/SlopDotCash/slopdotcash/issues/904#issuecomment-6434116522) use it.
  - Vault snapshot at 07:16 UTC: `0x6c1297c3…ed36`, block 53147297, every counter 0.

- [ ] **1.5 Run the referral testnet only on a checked contract.** #1442 removed the 7-day claim delay and changed `ReferralDistributor.sol`. Before the #1430 run, make sure that the escrow workflow passes on the `development` head that contains #1442 (see 1.2). The other steps stay in #1430 and #1366.

## 2. Checks only a human can do

- [ ] **2.1 Native Chrome 200% check of the owner funding page.**
  - Two of the three pending native checks are done: Codex ran the equivalent checks on production for `/how-it-works` and `/contributors/lalalune` ([#1046 comment](https://github.com/SlopDotCash/slopdotcash/issues/1046#issuecomment-6434179089)).
  - Left: `/projects/eliza/funding`. The local Codex preview server on port 58696 serves an old revision (`5ab5f319`). Check the live page instead.
  - Steps: sign in to https://slop.cash as the owner. Open https://slop.cash/projects/eliza/funding. Set Chrome zoom to 200%. Expected: no horizontal page scroll, every control is reachable with the keyboard, the focus is visible and no text is cut off. Record the result on #904.
  - After that, the local Codex preview servers on ports 62997 and 53668 are not needed. You can stop them. Agents do not stop processes that they did not start.

- [ ] **2.2 Watch the five-flows video before you share it.**
  - File: `evidence/walkthrough/slop-five-flows.mp4` in the local checkout (30:51; it shows the 25 October UI, commit `2a4e80b3`).
  - Watch 4:28–4:44 (Flow 1 setup status), 10:34–10:55 (Flow 2 program decisions) and 17:54–18:23 (Flow 3 payouts). These parts show older text.
  - Decide: publish it with the label "captured 25 October 2026", or ask for a new capture against current `development`.

- [ ] **2.3 Read-only database check after #1380.** A person with D1 read access runs the two `SELECT` queries in the Limitations section of #1380, on staging and production (`project_enforcements` in `slop-private`). Examine each matched row by hand. Do not change rows without a separate decision.

- [ ] **2.4 Census import of the Claude slopdotcash slice.**
  - An import is running now. Live reads at 07:17 UTC: canary #722 at 04:28 UTC, batch 01 at 04:33 UTC, batch 18 at 07:11 UTC; batches 20–30 not yet imported; work-unit journal through sequence 203.
  - When it finishes, the expected total is 314 work-unit records and 18 single records (`IMPORT-RUNBOOK.md` section 7). Post the read-back on #1046.
  - Do not import Codex's 20 slopdotcash envelopes from its 25 October artifacts (PRs 296, 310, 315-318-319, 376, 387, 389, 395, 396, 398, 399, 400, 420, 432, 436, 483, 484, 486, 498, 499, 502). 14 have the same digest as a Claude unit, and 6 group the work differently. This is also posted on #1046 for the Codex threads.

**Not needed:**

- A live #910 report from a non-admin account. The owner waived the live private-report checks on 26 October (#910; #1411 Part D1).
- A required reviewer and rulesets on the production environment. The old local `CLAUDE.md` asks for them, but the 25 October owner decision removed that requirement (`docs/release-environments.md`).
- A Claude takeover of the census of the other four repositories. Codex continues it ([#1046 comment, 05:29 UTC](https://github.com/SlopDotCash/slopdotcash/issues/1046#issuecomment-6434558149)). Decide again only if Codex stops.

## 3. Policy decisions

Each decision unblocks agent work. Answer here or on the linked issue.

- [ ] **3.1 Census Points for team accounts (#1046).** Owner decision 3 on #1046 (26 October, 23:36 UTC) says that team commits on mixed outcomes earn nothing. The current code (`shareScoreThirds` in `src/lib/leaderboard.ts`) gives each implementation actor an equal share. So team accounts get Points (not money) after publication. The same mix is in 63 assessed outcomes in 53 units, not only #478, #838 and #897. #478 has no outside actor. Decide: (a) accept equal Points shares (no money is paid, because no 2026-09/10 pool exists), or (b) approve a PRD change that removes team actors from historical Points before publication.
- [ ] **3.2 Removed account Madyoun (#1046).** GitHub returns the account again (ID 111367363) with its PRs. It is an implementation actor in 9 units (691; 695-696-757; 697-756-761-763-764-766; 715-754; 720-753-765; 725-752; 726; 1054-1061-1080-1082-1083-1149; 1196), not only the 5 named PRs. Confirm that "no payable credit" covers all 9 units, and decide whether its Points publish.
- [ ] **3.2b Merged work from the removed account `yasdrox` (#1466).** GitHub removed this account and its five merged PRs (#1410, #1432, #1437, #1438, #1443) on 27 October. The code stays on `main`. Decide how the leaderboard and Points treat removed PRs (the census rule in #1046 decision 1 is "no payable credit; the accepted work stays in history"). #1466 needs this rule.
- [ ] **3.3 Kept appeal and "Reinstate after review".** For a kept project appeal, `/admin` offers "Reinstate after review" (`src/AdminProjectEnforcement.tsx:25`). The server refuses it with `409 no_open_appeal` (`backend/projects/enforcement.ts:535–581`). This is a dead control. Decide whether a kept appeal can authorize reinstatement. An agent then enables the action or hides the control. Evidence: #1380, Limitations.
- [ ] **3.4 A new wallet registration pauses payouts before the new wallet signs.** `POST /api/v1/payments/wallets/register` adds the new claim before any wallet signature (`backend/payments/handler.ts:649`). Payouts go only to the newest claim, and only when it is authorized. So a GitHub session alone can pause payouts to a confirmed wallet. Decide: (a) keep this and document it, or (b) make the new claim active only at `/wallets/authorize`. #1459 shows the true state on the page in both cases.
- [ ] **3.5 Redirected wallet recovery.** PRD section 11 names "one operator for redirected wallet recovery". `POST /api/v1/payments/admin/wallet-proposals` writes `payment_wallet_proposals` (`backend/payments/handler.ts:635`), and no code reads that table. Account recovery on `/account` is a `mailto` link. Decide: define the operator flow (for example, a pending proposal that the contributor still signs on `/account`), or record `mailto` plus self-service as the recovery path and remove the write-only route.
- [ ] **3.6 Vault payments on public pages.** Profiles (`src/Profiles.tsx`) and `/cycles` show only old file cycles and direct transfers. No public page reads paid vault payments, and `cycles/` holds only `README.md`. Automatic monthly payments start with period 2026-11. Decide which finalized vault payments become public (project, period, net amount, transaction) on profiles and `/cycles`.
- [ ] **3.7 Owned-repository picker on `/projects/new`.** In production it returned `503 github_rate_limited` ([#908 comment](https://github.com/SlopDotCash/slopdotcash/issues/908#issuecomment-6409908690), 26 October). The optional `SLOP_GITHUB_READ_TOKEN` is not set, so the read is unauthenticated from shared Cloudflare egress. Manual `owner/name` entry works. Decide: set a read-only public GitHub token as that Pages secret (production and staging), or approve removal of the picker.
- [ ] **3.8 Published scoring contract.** https://slop.cash/protocol/scoring-v2.md starts with "Slop Score v2" and the old values 1/3, 1, 3, 8, 15 and 25. The site and the PRD use 10, 30, 90, 240, 450 and 750 Points. The current rule `slop-value-v1` starts at line 258. Approve: put the current Points rules first and mark the Score v2 sections as history. An agent then edits `protocol/scoring-v2.md`.
- [ ] **3.9 "Presentation-only" files for rescans (PRD section 8).** README or Markdown files can carry agent instructions. Define which file classes do not need a fresh scan. #1461 covers only identical content.
- [ ] **3.10 Cleanup-report removals (26 October consolidated report, section 8).** Answer yes or no for each: (a) retire `protocol/wallet-possession.md` (no client uses it); (b) retire the old isolated test identity stack and the v1 secure-VM vetting pipeline; (c) detach the retired `deck.slop.cash` domain (claim the deploy/DNS lever first; two deploy steps can wait up to 20 minutes for it); (d) allow CI caching (the Solana job takes about 45 minutes); (e) keep one shared fee wallet on Base, Ethereum and Robinhood Chain, or use one for each network. The quality-verifier item already has an owner decision (#1295).
- [ ] **3.11 Items without evidence in this pass.** The conversation review named: #1261 review credit; a retained-credit gap for placeholder PRs; and moderator self-review of a self-filed appeal (related text: #1380 Limitations, last item; #1390 changed this area). This pass found no evidence record for them. Tell an agent which to check. The single-provider Solana expiry item is #1411 E36.

## 4. Housekeeping

- [ ] **4.1 Free disk space (urgent).** At 07:12 UTC the local disk had 14 GiB free of 3.6 TiB (`df`). The shared checkout has 474 registered worktrees; 64 are `finish-*` worktrees from this pass. A full disk stops builds, browser tests and agents. After the workflow ends, remove the worktrees whose branches are merged and that have no unpushed commits. Keep `finish-fix-account-failure-states` (unpushed commit `6977b53d`) until #1459 has a PR. Also delete the video render intermediates (about 490 MB in `five-flows-render/out`) if you do not need them. Agents do not delete worktrees or data.
- [ ] **4.2 Main checkout.** The local `army` checkout is on `codex/slop-score-v2-activation` (`40d43fcd`, September) with 173 uncommitted changes. Its `CLAUDE.md` is old, so agents that start there read rules that are no longer valid. Decide: keep the changes on a branch, stash them or discard them. Then check out `development`.
- [ ] **4.3 Sessions and automations.** Clear the stale goals `9c870d4b`, `ff38e799`, `ba9e0f0f` and `01a1246e`. Review Codex automation `01a11386` (probably obsolete) and `01a16be3` (its "referral token absent" text is old). Do not resume sessions `42cd337a`, `6144289e`, `92d0e15b`, `ba9e0f0f` or `ff38e799` while the workflow runs.
- [ ] **4.4 Census tooling.** The census scripts exist only as untracked local files (`census-slop/tooling` and three local worktrees). Decide: commit them through a reviewed PR, or keep them as private evidence only.
- [ ] **4.5 Spam on #1411.** [This comment](https://github.com/SlopDotCash/slopdotcash/issues/1411#issuecomment-6435804619) (SilentHunter-250, 06:59 UTC) is an unrelated `/claim` with payout details. Hide it as spam (… → Hide → Spam). Agents do not change comments.
- [ ] **4.6 No new information:** #1411 E25 (unused `slop-data-refresh` environment and `SLOP_FUNDING_AUTOMERGE_ENABLED` variable) and E27 (DNSSEC).

Prepared from the finish-pass lane results and live read-only checks. No secret, setting, transaction, score or payment was read or changed.
